mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1800 and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105 for two consecutive months, it indicates synchronized strength in consumer demand and manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1800 and INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized for two consecutive quarters signals robust economic momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 285 for two consecutive months, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 285, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a monetary tightening cycle amid weak labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy and high unemployment
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing contraction regime that reduces corporate output and profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
